links.outcome: Therapeutic quality of chatbot before versus after expert-guided enhancement, rated by participants
links.effect: Mean scores rose from 5.40 to 7.63 (+2.23, 41%; dz=0.881); 13/15 (86.7%) preferred the enhanced version. Baseline and enhanced versions were compared in a small pilot.
links.quote: The enhanced system demonstrated substantial improvement in overall therapeutic quality, with mean scores increasing from 5.40 to 7.63 (Δ =+2.23 points, 41%; dz=0.881; 95% bootstrap CI [0.32-2.20]).

unlisted_practices: Iterative evaluation-to-enhancement loop using multi-LLM generated enhancement strategies mapped to expert-identified competency deficits

screen.reason: Empirically tests an evaluation-to-enhancement quality assurance decision support framework (EvaluationPlus) via an A/B within-subject validation study across simulated clinical scenarios.

primary.practice: expert-guided iterative quality assurance and enhancement loop
